newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares ease 0.53 pct, testing support.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares ease 0.53 pct, testing support.

text.p: Istanbul shares slipped lower in range-bound trade on Wednesday as the market tested support of the index at 81,000 in the absence of market moving expectations, brokers said.

The IMKB-100 closed 430.56 points, or 0.53 percent lower at 81,464.08 after moving between 80,984-82,964. Trade volume leapt to 19.27 trillion lira ($197.2 million) from 16.73 trillion lira ($172 million) on Tuesday.

"Sales that began in (largely state-owned petroleum refiner) Tupras in early afternoon spilled over to other issues. But the 81,000 support held. The index may continue drifting sideways with share-based activity," said Nazmi Sarikaya vfrom Disbank.

But some other brokers said the index could pierce down 81,000 on Thursday or Friday to test major support awaited at the 80,000 mark. Range-trading began after the market failed to pierce stiff resistance at 85,000 last Thursday.
The index had surged 29.3 percent from September 13 to an all-time high close of 83,772.33 on October 23, the tenth record in an uptrend which began with the breaching of 65,000 level.
